review.why: Writes Markdown documents and Mermaid diagrams from templates, with 23 diagram guides and render checks.
review.summary: Optional house style for Markdown documentation with Mermaid structural diagrams: nine document templates (ADR, status report, how-to, research paper...), a picker for 23 diagram types with a guide each, style guides, accessibility metadata, and a rule to render in the real destination and keep a text alternative.
strengths: Nine document templates, including decision record and status report
Diagram type picker with a copy-paste guide per type
Insists on testing the render in the real destination and keeping a text alternative
cautions: House rules are opinionated (one emoji per H2, one H1)
Scientific framing: quantitative charts need other tools
37 bundled files; the guides and templates are described, not read here
